sql: SELECT p.model_code, ROUND(AVG(s.score),2) AS avg_score, ROUND(SUM(t.reviews),2), COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM satisfaction_surveys s JOIN tickets t ON t.id=s.ticket_id JOIN devices dv ON dv.id=t.device_id JOIN products p ON p.id=dv.product_id WHERE s.submitted_at >= '2023-01-01' AND s.status='completed' GROUP BY p.model_code ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 200
